protocol_frozen_meaning: Phase 3 was an authorized diagnostic/regeneration verification, NOT a preregistered scientific experiment. protocol_frozen=false means Phase 3 itself had no preregistered protocol to freeze. The broader measurement/discrimination protocol (Phases 8-17) is not yet frozen — that occurs at Phase 13 per Amendment 6. Do not flip this to true merely because Phase 3 completed.
scientific_results_note: Phase 3 produced a REGENERATION VERDICT. This is a measurement result, not a discovery claim. The verdict is FAIL because M-008 (FP floor) does not regenerate to the same value as the committed artifact.
next_allowed_phase: 4 (with caveat: Phase 3 FAIL must be acknowledged)

test_1_bootstrap_all_metrics.interpretation: M-008 (FP floor / false-positive floor) does not regenerate. The committed artifact reports point_estimate=0.9189 but fresh computation produces 0.8889. This is a 3% discrepancy — not a floating-point precision issue but a real difference. Possible causes: (a) code change in M-008 since the committed artifact was generated, (b) dependency version difference affecting the random resampling, (c) data change in the gold set or entity pool. The discrepancy is NOT explained or explained away — it is recorded as a regeneration failure.

test_2_run_discovery_benchmark.interpretation: run_discovery_benchmark() reproduced the committed discovery_capability_score.json values exactly under the tested environment and invocation. f1=0.5714 matches. This establishes regeneration for this specific benchmark only — it does NOT generalize to the entire NLP pipeline or to other benchmarks not tested.

overall_verdict_reason: 1 of 2 regeneration tests passed. M-008 (bootstrap FP floor) does not regenerate to the committed value. Per the audit: REGENERATION = FAILED, not approximately equivalent. 36 of 38 metrics reproduced; 2 fields of M-008 did not reproduce. The failure of one metric matters disproportionately because M-008 is the FP floor used to determine whether the discovery matcher is discriminative (MC-5: FP floor > 5% blocks discovery claims).

m008_quarantine.note: M-008 is quarantined per audit round 6. No retroactive repair. No deletion. No replacement. No averaging. The discrepancy is an honest finding that must be causally attributed before M-008 can be trusted. Per MC-5, M-008 (FP floor) is critical-path for the matcher discrimination study.

comparison_rule: SEMANTIC (point estimates match within 1e-4 tolerance; integer counts match exactly). NOT 'approximately equivalent' — precise semantic comparison with tight tolerance. Per audit: no 'approximately equivalent' unless the preregistered comparison rule explicitly permits semantic equivalence, which it does not.

zai_response_schema_diagnostic.note: Independently captured CLI response confirms: z-ai CLI reports model='glm-4-plus' but does NOT report provider. This is now captured evidence, not just an implementation finding.
